pundit.name: Landon Donovan
pundit.take: **Devin, or "Ghost Pepper," drafting Haiti was akin to bringing a spoon to a knife fight, bless his heart.** Look, I understand Devin tries to add spice to this fantasy pool, but when you're relying on Spain to salvage your day against Zach's Austria, it's like hoping a single rocket will revitalize a broken down launch program. Spain's recent form has been solid, victorious in six of their last eight, but it's clear Devin's strategy might be a tad... scattered. Meanwhile, "Mustard Boy," or Zach, finds himself neck deep in the mustard of his own creation, clinging to Austria like it's a lifeboat in a sea of his own making. With all consideration, I think Spain will take this with an easy two-goal margin, solely based on Devin's hopeful yet misguided tactics. Ultimately, I feel for Devin, really, but when you bring in Haiti as a late draft pick, one wonders what conversation you were having with yourself.
